body: TAP Air Portugal is planning a significant change to its Porto–Luanda service, deploying the Airbus A321LR on the 3,737-mile (6,014 km) route from October 31, 2027. The move will create the airline's longest scheduled nonstop A321LR flight, narrowly surpassing its existing Lisbon–Belém service. According to AeroRoutes, TAP's preliminary winter 2027/28 schedule replaces the A330-900 with the A321LR on its twice-weekly service from Porto to Luanda, connecting northern Portugal with Angola's new Dr. António Agostinho Neto International Airport. The proposed schedule has TP293 leaving Porto on Friday afternoons and Sunday evenings, with TP294 returning from Luanda on Monday mornings and Friday nights.

The decision is particularly noteworthy because TAP intends to replace its 298-seat Airbus A330-900 with a 171-seat narrowbody, reducing passenger capacity by approximately 43%. The change will reduce weekly capacity from 1,192 to 684 seats across both directions, a reduction of 508 seats. TAP's A321LR accommodates 16 business-class and 155 economy passengers, compared with 34 business and 264 economy seats on its A330-900s. The smaller aircraft could allow TAP to better match capacity with demand while maintaining nonstop service.

When TAP first received the A321LR, then-CEO Antonoaldo Neves explained its strategic importance: “With its superior range, we can comfortably explore new markets in North America, South America and Africa from Portugal, and offer nonstop flights with the right size of aircraft.” However, the long sector raises operational questions. Airbus advertises an A321LR range of approximately 4,000 nautical miles, equivalent to 4,603 miles (7,408 km), comfortably exceeding Porto–Luanda's great-circle distance on paper, but range depends on payload and operating conditions; heavy checked baggage, commercial cargo, headwinds and fuel reserves could all influence performance. TAP has not announced any passenger or baggage restrictions, and whether either will be necessary remains unknown. The change remains provisional, with almost a year until its planned introduction.

The Porto–Luanda deployment will surpass TAP's Lisbon–Belém service by just 11 miles (18 km). TAP's planned 2027 A321LR network includes 16 nonstop routes exceeding 2,000 miles (3,219 km), and six of the ten longest connect Portugal with the Americas, three of them serving Brazil. The record applies only to nonstop flights: TAP has operated longer one-stop A321LR services, including Lisbon–Belém–Manaus, covering a combined 4,534 miles (7,297 km).
en.summary: TAP Air Portugal plans to deploy the Airbus A321LR on its Porto–Luanda service from October 31, 2027, creating the airline's longest scheduled nonstop A321LR flight at 3,737 miles and replacing the 298-seat Airbus A330-900 with a 171-seat narrowbody.
en.title: TAP Air Portugal plans longest A321LR route yet: Porto–Luanda at 3,737 miles

body: 葡萄牙航空計劃大幅調整波爾圖—羅安達航線，自2027年10月31日起以空中巴士A321LR執飛全程3737英里（6014公里）的航線，成為該公司最長的A321LR直飛定期航班，略微超越現有的里斯本—貝倫航線。根據AeroRoutes資料，葡萄牙航空2027/28年冬季初步班表將以A321LR取代A330-900，執飛每進兩班的波爾圖—羅安達航線，連接葡萄牙北部與安哥拉新建的羅安達內圖博士國際機場。初步班表列出TP293於進五下午與進日晚間自波爾圖出發，TP294於進一上午與進五深夜自羅安達返航。
這項調整備受關注，因為葡萄牙航空將以171座窄體客機取代298座空中巴士A330-900，載客量減少約43%。每進雙向座位數將由1192席降至684席，減少508席；A321LR配置16席商務艙與155席經濟艙，A330-900則為34席商務艙與264席經濟艙。較小的機型有助於葡萄牙航空在維持直飛服務的同時，讓運能更貼合需求。

葡萄牙航空首度接收A321LR時，時任執行長Antonoaldo Neves曾說明該機型的戰略重要性，指出其優異航程讓葡萄牙航空能從葡萄牙以合適機型開闢北美、南美與非洲新市場、提供直飛航班。不過，這條長程航線也引發營運上的疑問：空中巴士標示A321LR航程約4000海里，相當4603英里（7408公里），紙面上大幅超越波爾圖—羅安達3737英里的大圓距離，但實際航程取決於載重與營運條件；沉重的託運行李、商務貨物、逆風與燃油備量都可能影響性能。葡萄牙航空尚未公布任何旅客或行李限制，是否需要限制仍屬未知；這項調整仍為初步計劃，距預定上線還有近一年時間。
波爾圖—羅安達航線將以僅11英里（18公里）之差超越里斯本—貝倫航線。葡萄牙航空2027年A321LR計劃航網包含16條超過2000英里（3219公里）的直飛航線，其中最長的10條中有6條連接葡萄牙與美洲，3條飛往巴西。這項紀錄僅適用於直飛航班：葡萄牙航空曾營運更長的一站式A321LR航線，包括里斯本—貝倫—瑪努斯，合計4534英里（7297公里）。
zh.summary: 葡萄牙航空計劃2027年10月31日起以空中巴士A321LR執飛波爾圖—羅安達航線，全程3737英里，將成為該公司最長的A321LR直飛航線，並以171座窄體客機取代298座A330-900。
zh.title: 葡萄牙航空波爾圖—羅安達航線將改派A321LR，成為該公司最長A321LR直飛航線
